title: Optimal Hydra: Model Heterogeneous Federated Learning for LLMs using Data-Informed Hydra-Nets
abstract: arXiv:2610.20753v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) trained on vast amounts of data have demonstrated impressive performance over a range of tasks, but future performance gains will require increasing amounts of data and compute. Federated Learning (FL) facilitates training on decentralized private data, but client resource limitations can make training impractical, particularly as model sizes continue to expand. These resource constraints make the assumption of a shared server-client architecture impractical. Model heterogeneous FL offers a promising alternative by adapting model size to client capabilities; however, previous work is limited to the pre-training setting, and conclusions on sub-network selection do not necessarily hold for fine-tuning. Furthermore, prior approaches create client sub-networks without considering their unique data distributions, thereby overlooking the opportunity to tailor sub-network architecture to local data. translated_title: Optimal Hydra：使用数据感知的Hydra-Nets实现大语言模型的模型异构联邦学习
translated_abstract: 在海量数据上训练的大型语言模型（LLMs）在一系列任务中展现出令人印象深刻的性能，但未来的性能提升将需要越来越多的数据和计算资源。联邦学习（FL）支持在分散的私有数据上进行训练，但客户端的资源限制可能使训练变得不切实际，尤其是随着模型规模的持续扩大。这些资源限制使得共享的服务器-客户端架构假设变得难以实现。模型异构联邦学习通过将模型大小适配到客户端能力，提供了一种有前景的替代方案；然而，以往的工作仅限于预训练场景，且关于子网络选择的结论不一定适用于微调。此外，先前的方法在创建客户端子网络时没有考虑其独特的数据分布，从而忽视了将子网络架构与本地数据相匹配的机会。受证据启发……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Optimal Hydra方法，通过根据客户端本地数据分布定制异构的Hydra-Nets子网络架构，解决了资源受限客户端上大语言模型联邦微调的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Optimal Hydra, which enables federated fine-tuning of LLMs on resource-constrained clients by tailoring heterogeneous Hydra-Net sub-network architectures to clients' unique local data distributions.
